label: Spatial correlation of ln IM between bridges

period_s.description: Spectral period of the IM the field describes; sets the correlation range. Required for jayaram-baker-2009.

vs30_clustered.description: Jayaram & Baker (2009) case 2 (Vs30 clustered, b = 40.7 - 15.0 T) rather than case 1 (b = 8.5 + 17.2 T). Matters only below T = 1 s; at and above it b = 22.0 + 3.7 T either way.

source.citation: Jayaram, N. and Baker, J. W. (2009). Correlation model for spatially distributed ground-motion intensities. Earthquake Engineering & Structural Dynamics 38(15), 1687-1708.

description: The correlation R between the ln IM of a hazard field's bridges: R_ij = exp(-3 h_ij / b), h_ij the great-circle distance in km and b the range at the IM's period, or R = I for independent bridges. The field is ln IM ~ N(mu, D R D), D = diag(sigma), with mu and sigma from the function (a GMM, a ShakeMap). Applied to a total sigma, or to a ShakeMap's station-conditioned sigma, it is an approximation: Jayaram & Baker fit it to within-event residuals, and conditioning on stations changes the correlation.
